description:
codebase-consistency-hooks v0.3.0: two-mode Claude Code adapter around scripts/check_pattern_consistency.py.

Stop hook (blocking): fires when Claude finishes a turn. If changed files diverge from the dominant existing convention, sends Claude back to reconcile before the turn ends. Uses --format claude-code-stop, which emits {decision, reason} JSON and always exits 0 per Claude Code protocol.

PostToolUse hook (non-blocking, earlier signal): fires after each Write/Edit/MultiEdit tool call. Injects convention findings as additional context into Claude's next turn — earlier awareness, no hard block. Uses --format claude-code-context.

Both hooks call the same harness-agnostic engine. Neither uses the experimental agent hook type.
